policy_verdict.pilot_training_policy: EXCLUDE all 2,300 HIGH/CRITICAL records from the initial Pilot Training run. Pilot training will use purely verified, routine customer inquiries, product recommendations, catalog discovery, and non-critical service workflows.
policy_verdict.full_training_policy: Approved logistics records (1,150) may be included in the full 8,000 training run after pilot validation. Quarantined critical safety/fraud records (1,150) remain in quarantine until explicit founder sign-off.
